title: browser_navigate
description: Navigate the active tab to a URL. Default wait_until is domcontentloaded with a 15s goto timeout. If that times out after the document has committed, the tool returns ok with timed_out true, url, title, and wait_until so the model can snapshot instead of retrying.

wait_until.description: Playwright waitUntil; default domcontentloaded. Null = default. Explicit load, networkidle, or commit are honored. A 15s goto timeout that still committed returns ok with timed_out true rather than an error.
